fieldNotes.location: Roster coordinates (39.828255,-84.898477, APPROXIMATE) pointed at downtown Richmond - wrong. Web research (PetfoodIndustry, EDC Wayne County, Citymapper) identified the $200M Blue Buffalo natural pet food plant at 4878/4748 W Industries Rd in the Wayne County Midwest Industrial Park west of Richmond, off I-70. Locked center 39.8550,-84.9645 by satellite - a large 125-acre manufacturing campus.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single private access road leaves W Industries Rd on the SE side and feeds the loop road that encircles the plant. The whole 125-acre campus is enclosed by a chain-link perimeter fence (clearly visible in 2024-08 Street View along W Industries Rd). Treated as a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth resolvable in satellite; 2024-08 Street View covers the public road only and does not extend onto the private access road, so a booth at the entrance cannot be confirmed or ruled out. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the assumption of a fenced/gated entrance without a confirmed staffed booth - low confidence, flagged.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long private access road plus an encircling loop road give deep stacking room for 3+ trucks before any dock.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide loop road and large paved aprons leave ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank runs the full SW/W wall of the main warehouse with ~30-40 trailers backed in; the NE expansion building has its own dock face with additional doors. Total well over 50 - banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A long row of perpendicular drop trailers lines the W side of the loop road, plus additional staged trailers - roughly 25-50 trailer stalls. Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock clusters on different buildings: the main warehouse SW dock bank and the NE expansion building's own dock face - supports separate shipping/receiving.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus with three distinct building clusters - production tower/main plant, the long SW warehouse, and the standalone NE expansion/R&D building.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows along the loop road, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits in the Midwest Industrial Park surrounded by farmland west of Richmond - Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the colored strips NW of the production tower are landscaping/utility features, not rail.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~122 acres, consistent with the reported 125-acre campus.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Three primary buildings counted; smaller ancillary structures not counted separately.
